about.en: Bond University, established in 1987, is one of Australia's premier recognized universities, holding a prominent global position (Rank 571 QS World University Rankings 2025 (#1 in Australia for Student Experience for 18 Years)). The university delivers world-class academic education and cutting-edge research in close collaboration with leading global industries, offering international students a dynamic multicultural campus and exceptional graduate career prospects.
